mcq.q: In a 4x1 MUX, with S1 = 1 and S0 = 0 (standard convention, S1 is the most significant select bit), which input is passed to the output?
mcq.explanation: S1S0 = 10 is binary 2, so I2 is selected. (The slide table lists S0 first; check your teacher convention.)

mcq.q: A 8x1 MUX needs how many select lines?
mcq.explanation: 2^3 = 8, so 3 select lines.

mcq.q: In a 1x4 DEMUX with select lines S1S0 = 11, the output that becomes active is:
mcq.explanation: S1S0 = 11 is binary 3, so Y3 gets the input.

mcq.q: A 2x4 decoder has how many output lines?
mcq.explanation: 2 inputs give 2^2 = 4 outputs.

mcq.q: A decoder with input 101 (3 bits) activates which output in a 3x8 decoder?
mcq.explanation: Binary 101 = decimal 5, so output 5 is activated.

mcq.q: An 8x3 encoder has:
mcq.explanation: Encoder has 2^n inputs and n outputs; for n = 3, 8 inputs and 3 outputs.

mcq.q: In a 4-bit SISO shift register, how many clock pulses are needed to shift a 4-bit serial word in fully?
mcq.explanation: One bit is shifted in per clock pulse, so 4 pulses are needed.

mcq.q: A register that loads all bits at once and gives output bit by bit is:
mcq.explanation: Parallel In Serial Out (PISO).

mcq.q: A 3-bit binary counter has how many distinct states?
In a synchronous counter, the flip-flops are driven by:
options: The output of the last flip-flop only
mcq.explanation: All flip-flops share one clock in a synchronous counter.

mcq.q: Which counter is also called a ripple counter?
mcq.explanation: Asynchronous counters are called ripple counters because the carry ripples from stage to stage.

mcq.q: A 16-bit register is built from how many flip-flops?
mcq.explanation: One flip-flop per bit, so 16.

mcq.q: An IC with 10 to 200 gates is classified as:
mcq.explanation: MSI (Medium Scale Integration).

mcq.q: A chip with more than 1 million transistors is classified as:
mcq.explanation: ULSI (Ultra Large Scale Integration) has more than 1 million transistors.

mcq.q: Which is an application of counters?
mcq.explanation: Counters are used in digital clocks, watches, pulse generators and alarm systems.

mcq.q: Which device sends one input line to one of many output lines?
mcq.explanation: DEMUX is one to many.

mcq.q: A MUX with 16 inputs requires how many select lines?
mcq.explanation: 2^4 = 16, so 4 select lines.

mcq.q: Binary to hexadecimal conversion uses which decoder?
mcq.explanation: Hex needs 16 outputs from 4 bits.

mcq.q: In a bidirectional shift register, data can be shifted:
mcq.explanation: A bidirectional shift register can shift left or right.

mcq.q: Advantage of synchronous counters over asynchronous counters is:
mcq.explanation: All flip-flops change together, so they are faster.

mcq.q: In the 8x3 encoder, output X is equal to:
mcq.explanation: From the slide circuit: X = D4+D5+D6+D7.

mcq.q: In the 8x3 encoder, output Z is equal to:
mcq.explanation: From the slide circuit: Z = D1+D3+D5+D7.

mcq.q: In the 8x3 encoder, when input D0 is active, the output XYZ is:
mcq.explanation: D0 is not part of any output equation, so the outputs are 000 for D0.

mcq.q: Which device is said to have the most common component as NAND, NOR or inverter gate?
mcq.explanation: The slide says the most common component in VLSI technology is NAND, NOR or inverter.

mcq.q: Another name of synchronous counter is:
mcq.explanation: A synchronous counter is also called a simultaneous counter.

mcq.q: In the 1x4 DEMUX truth table on the slide, the select lines are written as S1 then S0. With S1 = 0 and S0 = 1 and D = 1, which output is 1?
mcq.explanation: S1S0 = 01 selects F1.

mcq.q: In the 3x8 decoder truth table on the slide (columns A0, A1, A2), which output is active when A0A1A2 = 110?
mcq.explanation: On the slide, A0 is the first column (most significant). A0=1, A1=1, A2=0 is the 7th row, which is D7.

mcq.q: In the 8x3 encoder truth table, when input D5 is high, the output XYZ is:
mcq.explanation: The slide's table gives XYZ = 101 for D5.

mcq.q: In the 2x1 MUX truth table, when S0 = 1 the output is:
mcq.explanation: S0 = 1 selects I1.

mcq.q: In a 1x4 DEMUX with select lines S1S0 = 11, which output receives the input D?
mcq.explanation: S1S0 = 11 = 3, so F3 receives D.

mcq.q: How many D flip-flops does the 4-bit shift register circuit use?
mcq.explanation: The circuit cascades four flip-flops, one per bit.

mcq.q: IC ka base material kya hai?
mcq.explanation: An IC is a silicon chip with many interconnected gates and components, mounted in a ceramic or plastic package.

mcq.q: Sabse chhota IC scale kaunsa hai?
mcq.explanation: IC types from small to large scale: SSI, MSI, LSI, VLSI, SLSI and ULSI.

mcq.q: MSI mein kitne gates hote hain?
mcq.explanation: SSI: about 10 transistors or a few gates. MSI: 10 to 200 gates (decoders, adders, registers). LSI: 200 to 1000 gates. VLSI: 1000 to 10,000 gates.

mcq.q: ULSI mein transistors kitne hote hain?
mcq.explanation: SLSI: 10,000 to 100,000 gates (microprocessors). ULSI: more than 1 million transistors on one chip.

mcq.q: 2x4 decoder mein kitne outputs hote hain?
mcq.explanation: Inputs A0 and A1, enable, and outputs D1 to D4. The enable pin switches the decoder on.

mcq.q: Decoder mein enable 0 ho to output kya hoga?
mcq.explanation: With enable = 1, the output matching the input code is 1 and the rest are 0. For A1A0 = 10, output D3 is 1.

mcq.q: 2x4 decoder mein D2 ka expression kya hai?
mcq.explanation: Each output is an AND gate of the inputs (true or complemented) and the enable line. Inverters make the complemented inputs.

mcq.q: 3x8 decoder mein kitne inputs hote hain?
mcq.explanation: A 3x8 decoder has inputs A0, A1, A2, an enable, and 8 outputs D1 to D8.

mcq.q: 3x8 decoder mein kitne AND gates hote hain?
mcq.explanation: Inverters create complemented inputs, and one AND gate per output combines the inputs with the enable.

mcq.q: Encoder ka Z output kin inputs par 1 hota hai?
mcq.explanation: X = D4+D5+D6+D7, Y = D2+D3+D6+D7, Z = D1+D3+D5+D7. Each output is an OR of the inputs whose code has that bit set to 1.

mcq.q: 2x1 MUX mein kitne data inputs hote hain?
mcq.explanation: A 2x1 MUX has two data inputs I0 and I1, one select line S0, and one output Y.

mcq.q: 2x1 MUX mein S0 = 1 par output kya hai?
mcq.explanation: When S0 = 0 the output is I0. When S0 = 1 the output is I1.

mcq.q: 2x1 MUX mein S0 = 0 par output kya hai?
mcq.explanation: Two AND gates (one with S0 inverted) feed an OR gate, which passes either I0 or I1.

mcq.q: 4x1 MUX mein kitni select lines hoti hain?
mcq.explanation: A 4x1 MUX has inputs I0 to I3, select lines S0 and S1, and output Y.

mcq.q: 4x1 MUX mein kitne AND gates hote hain?
mcq.explanation: Four AND gates, each enabled by one decoded select combination, feed a single OR gate.

mcq.q: 1x4 DEMUX mein kitne outputs hote hain?
mcq.explanation: A 1x4 DEMUX takes one input D and sends it to one of the outputs F0 to F3, chosen by S0 and S1.

mcq.q: 1x4 DEMUX mein S1S0 = 00 par kaunsa output?
mcq.explanation: Four AND gates with decoded select lines. The input D goes to all four AND gates.

mcq.q: 4-bit shift register mein kitne flip-flops hote hain?
mcq.explanation: Flip-flops are chained: each output feeds the next D input, and all share one clock. Data moves one stage per clock pulse.

mcq.q: SISO mein serial out kab milta hai?
mcq.explanation: Serial in, serial out. Bits enter and leave one at a time. The diagram shows shifting in both directions.

mcq.q: SIPO register ka output kaisa hota hai?
mcq.explanation: Serial in, parallel out. After n clock pulses all n bits can be read in parallel.

mcq.q: PIPO register shift karta hai?
mcq.explanation: Parallel in, parallel out. All bits are loaded and read together.

mcq.q: Serial in, parallel out register ka naam kya hai?
mcq.explanation: Parallel in, serial out. Bits are loaded in parallel and then shifted out one at a time.

mcq.q: Bidirectional register mein right shift par input kis side se?
mcq.explanation: Data can shift left or right, depending on a control input.

mcq.q: Ripple counter kaunsa counter hai?
mcq.explanation: In the synchronous counter the clock reaches every flip-flop. In the asynchronous counter each stage is clocked by the previous one, so the change ripples.

mcq.q: 4-bit counter mein A0 kab toggle hota hai?
options: Har clock par (count enable 1 ho to)
mcq.explanation: Four JK flip-flops share one clock. The count-enable and AND gates decide which flip-flops toggle, giving counts 0 to 15.

mcq.q: Timing diagram mein har clock pulse par count kitna badhta hai?
mcq.explanation: The chart shows the clock and outputs A, B, C and D. Each clock pulse moves the count to the next value.

short.q: Explain the working of a 4x1 multiplexer with select lines S1 = 1, S0 = 0 (standard convention).
short.answer: Binary 10 selects input I2, so the output Y equals I2.

short.q: Draw the basic idea of a 1x4 DEMUX and state how many select lines it uses.
short.answer: One input line D goes to one of four outputs Y0 to Y3 chosen by the two select lines S1 and S0; it uses 2 select lines.

short.q: How many outputs does a 3x8 decoder have and why?
short.answer: 8 outputs, because 3 input lines can represent 2^3 = 8 different codes.

short.q: Differentiate between an encoder and a decoder.
short.answer: A decoder has n inputs and 2^n outputs and activates one output for each input code. An encoder has 2^n inputs and n outputs and produces the binary code of the active input. Encoder is the reverse of decoder.

short.q: Name the four shift register types and give one example use for SIPO.
short.answer: SISO, SIPO, PISO, PIPO. SIPO converts serial data into parallel form, e.g. a serial-to-parallel converter.

short.q: Give the number of flip-flops and the number of states for a 4-bit binary counter.
Why is an asynchronous counter slower than a synchronous counter?
short.answer: In an asynchronous counter each flip-flop is clocked by the previous one, so changes ripple through stage by stage, causing a delay.

short.q: Classify an IC that has 1000 to 10,000 gates and give an example.
Write the output equations of the 8x3 encoder for X, Y and Z.
List two advantages and one disadvantage of synchronous counters.
short.answer: Advantages: simple to design (compared to asynchronous), works simultaneously, no propagation delay, faster operation. Disadvantage: needs large components and complex logic as number of states increases (any valid answer).

short.q: Draw the block diagram of a 2x4 decoder with enable and label all pins.
short.answer: Inputs A0 and A1; enable; outputs D1, D2, D3, D4.

short.q: In one line, how does a synchronous counter differ from an asynchronous counter?
short.answer: In a synchronous counter all flip-flops change together from one clock; in an asynchronous counter each change ripples from stage to stage.
